title: The Ass and the Lap-Dog
author: Aesop (trans. V. S. Vernon Jones)
summary: 驴羡慕哈巴狗的宠爱，模仿它撒欢，结果挨了一顿毒打。
publicDomainBasis: Aesop's fables are ancient; this translation by V. S. Vernon Jones was published in 1912. Public domain in the United States and in China.

paragraphs.en: There was once a man who had an Ass and a lapdog. The Ass was housed in the stable with plenty of oats and hay to eat and was as well off as an ass could be. The little Dog was made a great pet of by his master, who fondled him and often let him lie in his lap; and if he went out to dinner, he would bring back a titbit or two to give him when he ran to meet him on his return.
paragraphs.zh: 从前有个人，养了一头驴和一只哈巴狗。驴住在马厩里，有充足的燕麦和干草吃，日子过得算是一头驴能有的最好光景。小狗却成了主人的宝贝，主人抚摸它，常让它躺在自己腿上；要是出门赴宴，回来时还会带一两块好吃的，等小狗跑上来迎接时给它。

paragraphs.en: The Ass had, it is true, a good deal of work to do, carting or grinding the corn, or carrying the burdens of the farm: and ere long he became very jealous, contrasting his own life of labour with the ease and idleness of the lapdog. At last one day he broke his halter, and frisking into the house just as his master sat down to dinner, he pranced and capered about, mimicking the frolics of the little favourite, upsetting the table and smashing the crockery with his clumsy efforts. Not content with that, he even tried to jump on his master's lap, as he had so often seen the dog allowed to do.
paragraphs.zh: 驴确实有不少活要干：拉车、磨面，或者驮农场的重物。没过多久，它便非常嫉妒，把自己劳碌的生活和哈巴狗的安逸闲散一比，心里很不平衡。终于有一天，它挣断缰绳，趁主人刚坐下吃饭时蹦进屋里，又跳又蹦，模仿那小宝贝的嬉闹，结果笨手笨脚地掀翻了桌子，打碎了碗碟。它还不满足，甚至想跳到主人腿上，就像它常看见小狗被允许做的那样。

paragraphs.en: At that the servants, seeing the danger their master was in, belaboured the silly Ass with sticks and cudgels, and drove him back to his stable half dead with his beating. "Alas!" he cried, "all this I have brought on myself. Why could I not be satisfied with my natural and honourable position, without wishing to imitate the ridiculous antics of that useless little lapdog?"
paragraphs.zh: 仆人们见主人有危险，便用棍棒狠狠揍了这头傻驴，把它打得半死，赶回马厩。“唉！”它叫道，“这都是我自找的。我为什么不能安于自己自然又体面的位置，非要去学那没用的小哈巴狗的荒唐把戏呢？”
